baslik: "Medicare" is calling. What do you share?

ilk_kare.hareket: Telefon titreşerek çalıyor, ekranda arayan adı 'MEDICARE' (kurgusal arayüz)

sahneler.ekran_yazisi: A) NUMBER B) LAST FOUR C) NOTHING

govde: A: your Medicare number. B: just the last four digits. C: nothing — hang up and call 1-800-MEDICARE yourself.

It's C. Medicare doesn't call to verify your number, and the name on the screen isn't proof. Real help is one call away, on a number you dial yourself. Your number can be billed for things you never got.
